Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The
reported mechanism is consistent with the knee injury described, and the nature and force of the impact align well
with the findings documented at intake. Initial evaluation included a detailed history and physical examination.
Several orthopedic findings support a soft tissue injury to the knee, including localized tenderness and reduced range
of motion on flexion, while other provocative tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the
same body region is known from the patient's history or avaliable records. Care was delivered over 21 visits and
consisted of physical therapy, anti-inflammatory medication management, and home exercise instruction. Treatment
progressed in a typical pattern, with visit frequency reduced steadily as symptoms improved and function returned.
Billing records reflect services that align with the documented plan of care, with no repeated or duplicate charges.
Patient was discharged from active care with a plan for self-directed exercise and follow-up as needed.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
